title: devwork · backlog.md — the plan. The backlog IS the plan and is not re-derived.

rule.description: the standing rule that governs how phases close, e.g. every phase closes with its acceptance executed

phases.description: ordered. Sequence position is the dependency order.

acceptance.description: the command that proves this phase closed, and its expected output

gate.description: what must be true before this phase may start

closed_on.description: ISO date; set only when state=closed

deferred.description: carried to a later stage. One line each, so the user decides. This is the only artifact where naming excluded work is correct, because here it is scope control rather than a loader priming a model.
